verdict.rationale: Gaudi 3 ships an extensive developer documentation site, so offering agent-oriented docs is a fair question for it. However, direct probes found no llms.txt at docs.habana.ai (HTTP 404) and no markdown rendition of the docs (HTTP 404). Nothing in the evidence describes any agent-oriented documentation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
